body: gitleaks flags AWS's own published example token/signatures in plugins/aws/testdata/sigv4. Chosen: .gitleaksignore with the five exact fingerprints (narrowest allowlist), keeping full vector coverage of the signed session-token header. Alternatives: drop the two vector folders (less coverage) or a path-wide allowlist (would hide a real future leak in that folder). Also renamed a vault example field from password to apikey so lore's password_pair rule does not trip on a fake value.
title: Keep AWS SigV4 session-token vectors; allowlist by fingerprint
